items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Mr. Kurtzfield' only as a student in a music theory class whose work the teacher praised: 'Oh, Mr. Kurtzfield, I like that deceptive cadence.' There is no indication of a personal relationship or direct interaction between Benny Golson and Mr. Kurtzfield.

ctx.x: So how did you get to Howard? Can you talk about finishing up high school? How did you decide to go to Howard?

This friend of mine – I told you when the first gig I had, he knocked on my door, asking could I join his band, and my first gig was $4 – he was a little older than me – he went to Howard, and he was telling me how it was. He said, “Here are the guys, in music school, what they’re doing.” I said, “Really?” I said, “Maybe I ought to try to go there.” He said okay. So I applied, but I had to take an entrance exam. I went down there. I had to play before the teachers. I got up on stage, and I had my saxophone. They…
